 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows/columns are the color distinct from the two data colors.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep_color for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_groups, col_groups = [], []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    base = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != sep_color and sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) > 0)
    anomaly = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != sep_color and v != base)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == anomaly for r in rs for c in cs) >= 2 else base
             for cs in col_groups] for rs in row_groups]
"
}
